sum: TROOPS, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides consultancy services for insurance products in Hong Kong, Australia, and the People's Republic of China. The company also provides mortgage, personal, and corporate loans; and advisory and referral services in relation to the application of migration, education and visa renewal to its customers. In addition, it is involved in property lease and management; development, operation, and management of an online financial marketplace for financial technology solutions, including API services. The company was formerly known as SGOCO Group, Ltd. and changed its name to TROOPS, Inc. in November 2021. TROOPS, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
